map.输入境外已纳所得税额与抵免限额，按 抵扣额=min(境外已纳,抵免限额) 计算可: Enter foreign income tax paid and credit limit, compute creditable amount by deductible = min(foreign paid, credit limit), for resident enterprises to determine foreign tax credit when avoiding international double taxation.
map.可抵扣 = min(境外已纳, 抵免限额): Deductible = min(foreign tax paid, credit limit)

map.超出限额部分结转以后年度。: Excess over the limit carries forward to later years.
map.：可抵扣额 = min(2000, 1500) = 1,500 元；超出限额的: : creditable amount = min(2000, 1500) = 1,500 yuan; the 500 yuan over the limit can be carried forward to later years.
map.：若境外已缴 1200、限额 1500，则可全额抵免 1200 元，无结转。: : if foreign paid 1200, limit 1500, then full credit 1200 yuan, no carryforward.

map.抵免限额如何确定？: How to determine the credit limit?
map.通常按境外所得按本国税法计算的应纳税额占全球所得比例确定分国/综合限额。: Usually the per-country/overall limit is determined by the ratio of tax payable on foreign income under domestic law to global income.
map.超限额部分怎么办？: What about the excess over the limit?
map.超出部分一般可在规定年限（如 5 年）内用以后年度余额结转抵免。: The excess can generally be carried forward within a specified number of years (e.g. 5) to offset in later years.
